metadata.question: Was there more than 12 mg/m^2 of black carbon concentrate at (40.190004, -122.555169) on August 25, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about black carbon concentration at a specific location and date. Black carbon is an atmospheric aerosol, so I need to use appropriate satellite data for aerosol monitoring. For black carbon/aerosol data in GEE, I should consider: 1. MODIS aerosol products (MOD04_L2 or MYD04_L2 for Terra/Aqua) 2. VIIRS aerosol products 3. MERRA-2 reanalysis data (which has black carbon specifically) Let me check what's available: - MODIS: MOD04_L2 (Terra) and MYD04_L2 (Aqua) have aerosol optical depth but not specifically black carbon - VIIRS: Similar aerosol products - MERRA-2: Has specific black carbon fields (BCSMASS, BCPHIL, BCPHOB for different types) MERRA-2 would be the best choice since it has specific black carbon mass concentration fields. The MERRA-2 collection is "M2I1NXASM" or "M2T1NXAER" for aerosol diagnostics. Let me structure this: 1. Define the point geometry and date 2. Use MERRA-2 collection for black carbon data 3. Check if data exists for that date 4. Extract black carbon concentration value 5. Compare with threshold (12 mg/m^2) Note: MERRA-2 black carbon is typically in kg/kg, so I'll need to convert to mg/m^2 using air density. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.555169, 40.190004]); const date = '2020-08-25'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MERRA-2 for black carbon const collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GSFC/MERRA/aer/2') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(point); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MERRA-2 Images on ${date}: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get black carbon data const image = collection.first(); // Black carbon mass mixing ratio (kg/kg) - using total black carbon const bcMixingRatio = image.select('BCSMASS'); // Convert to concentration (mg/m^3) using air density // Air density from MERRA-2 (kg/m^3) const airDensity = image.select('RHOA'); const bcConcentration = bcMixingRatio.multiply(airDensity).multiply(1e6); // Convert kg/m^3 to mg/m^3 // 4. Extract value at point const result = bcConcentration.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const bcValue = result.get('BCSMASS').getInfo(); const pixelCount = bcConcentration.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BCSMASS').getInfo(); console.log(`Black Carbon: ${bcValue ? bcValue.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m³`); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (bcValue === null || bcValue === undefined || !isFinite(bcValue)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (bcValue > 12) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
